newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire radio tells troops to return to barracks.
newsitem.headline: Zaire radio tells troops to return to barracks.

text.p: Zaire's state radio on Saturday read a statement from Prime Minister General Likulia Bolongo calling on all fighting army units to return to their barracks and urging civilians to stay in their homes.
"All combat units should return to barracks," the statement said.
The prime minister said the situation was serious, but urged people to remain calm.
In a bid to avert clashes, he called on rebel units to hold their positions and pledged to continue a mediating role and to try to ensure peace.

Sounds of gunfire heard in the capital earlier in the day had tapered off considerably by noon (1100 GMT), although a correspondent who tried to cross the city from one international hotel to another encountered a tank blocking one of the main boulevards and turned back.
